EuroPeir Hub

A portal that asks once and asks correctly

Every job used to start as an email, a call or a WhatsApp message, typed in again by dispatch and followed by a call back for whatever was missing. I designed the portal that replaces those messages: a request built around what the customer can see, and a page that answers the follow-up questions before anyone picks up the phone.
